newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA HANG ON TO BEAT RACING AND CLOSE GAP ON REAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA HANG ON TO BEAT RACING AND CLOSE GAP ON REAL.

text.p: Beleaguered Barcelona coach Bobby Robson saw his side reduce Real Madrid's lead at the top of the Spanish league to six points after hanging on for a 1-0 home win over Racing Santander on Sunday.
Robson's side went ahead at the end of the first half but were forced to struggle at the end after striker Juan Pizzi was sent off just two minutes after coming on as substitute.
Real Madrid had drawn 2-2 with third-placed Real Betis on Saturday.
Real Madrid have 56 points, Barcelona 50 and Real Betis 46.
Real Sociedad moved to fourth on 41 despite managing only a goalless draw at Sporting Gijon but could be overhauled by either Deportivo Coruna or Atletico Madrid who were meeting later on Sunday.

In other games Athletic Bilbao's Ismael Urzaiz scored a superb hat-trick earn his side a 3-2 victory over Oviedo, while struggling Extremadura continued their revival by moving off the bottom with a 1-0 win over Rayo Vallecano.
